intro: Hi! I took your notes and your voice notes and turned the nine options into two.
Both mix what you loved: the green cutting mat with your cut-outs on it, the Saturn ring for your art, your logo alone in the corner, and the orange section with your photo.
Use the arrows to go between them. Each one is a real page you can scroll and click. For now it's the home page only.
Tell me here what you like and what you don't, tap Favorite on the one you like best, and press Send at the end.
